categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in software and information technology services, with four main business segments: smart government affairs (智慧政务), intelligent manufacturing (智能制造), smart cities (智慧城市), and smart healthcare (智慧健康). Key business areas include digital conference systems, tobacco industry informatization solutions, banknote inspection technology, oil and gas field digitalization, and emerging businesses such as smart healthcare and low-code development platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is high-speed machine vision and intelligent analysis, which applies to real-time quality detection in high-speed continuous manufacturing. Key technologies include artificial intelligence, machine learning algorithms, computer vision, intelligent identification and analysis, IoT, cloud computing, big data analytics, and virtual simulation. The company employs integrated product development (IPD) methodology and maintains a two-level R&D system at company and business unit levels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and large industrial companies across multiple sectors. Key industries served are tobacco (covering agricultural, industrial, and commercial supply chains), oil and gas, government and public institutions, digital conference/meeting sectors, and emerging healthcare markets. The company maintains stable customer relationships with over 34.95% of customers having cooperation periods exceeding five years.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. It has established 13 provincial branches and subsidiary companies, with regional service centers covering seven major regions: North China, East China, Central China, South China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast. The company has expanded market presence to provinces including Shanghai, Shandong, Yunnan, and Guizhou, with distribution networks across 16 provinces and autonomous regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream to downstream solution provider in the software and information technology services supply chain. It integrates upstream hardware components, software platforms, and services to deliver comprehensive information technology solutions. The company handles system design, software development, hardware procurement, integration, installation, and after-sales technical support and maintenance services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI-driven technology innovation, developing machine vision large models and industry-specific vertical models, promoting informatization and digitalization across key industries, and expanding into emerging business areas. R&D focuses on edge intelligence industrial IoT platforms (EIOD), low-code development platforms, AI-assisted medical systems, intelligent video analysis, and autonomous controllable technologies. The company emphasizes self-controlled and domestically-developed solutions aligned with national information technology innovation (信创) initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through three channels: (1) Information technology solution projects combining system design, software development, hardware integration, and implementation services; (2) Technical development and customization services for specific client needs; (3) Service revenue including system maintenance, technical support, system upgrades, and conference equipment rental services. Revenue recognition occurs upon project completion, customer acceptance, or service delivery based on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of AI-based industry informatization solutions. It holds leading market positions in digital conference systems (40+ years of service to national conferences), tobacco industry informatization (top 3 supplier), banknote inspection technology (only global provider with full-process solutions), and oil and gas digitalization. The company faces increasing competition from emerging technology firms and traditional IT service providers, with market competition intensifying particularly in government informatization and intelligent manufacturing sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized software and IT services enterprise with 2024 revenue of 507 million yuan, representing a 14.27% decline from 2023's 591.4 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 9.58 million yuan (down 75.10% year-over-year), with total assets of 1.193 billion yuan. The company achieved new contract signings of 657 million yuan (4% growth). The company maintains stable asset-liability structure with 638 employees and operates as a high-tech enterprise with 15% corporate tax rate.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Deep industry expertise combining technical excellence with 30+ years of domain knowledge in target sectors; (2) Proprietary high-speed machine vision and AI intelligent analysis technologies providing superior detection accuracy and speed; (3) Comprehensive end-to-end solutions integrating hardware, software, and services; (4) Strong brand reputation as trusted partner for national-level projects and government agencies; (5) Self-developed, domestically-controlled technologies aligned with national information security and innovation initiatives; (6) Stable long-term customer relationships built on reliable service delivery and business integrity.
